t: A research toolkit that lets young students train a motor to react to sensors.
steps: Search for the Smart Motor paper to read the full study.
Contact the paper authors to ask whether the kit is available to schools.
Ask what hardware, software, and platforms the kit needs.
Ask for a parts list and setup steps before planning a class.
Plan a small trial with a few students once the kit is confirmed.
Prepare a short talk on how a nearest neighbor model decides.
